repos.name: wide-world-importers
repos.notes: Only the wide-world-importers/wwi-ssdt subtree of the sql-server-samples monorepo is cloned locally (the full monorepo is unrelated samples and far larger than needed). Full multi-schema business-app DDL: tables, views, functions, procs across Application/Sales/Purchasing/Warehouse/Security schemas. No CREATE DATABASE statement seen in the SSDT project, so default collation is unknown - CLAUDE.md: never guess.

repos.name: dnn-platform
repos.notes: 339 .SqlDataProvider files (DNN Platform/Website/Providers/DataProviders/SqlDataProvider/ plus per-module Providers/DataProviders/SqlDataProvider/ under DNN Platform/Modules/*). DDL and stored procedures are interleaved in the same incremental-upgrade files, not split into separate table/proc paths, hence the identical globs. IMPORTANT: files use {databaseOwner}/{objectQualifier} template tokens (by convention 'dbo.' and '' respectively) that must be substituted before ScriptDOM can parse them - see templateSubstitutions below.

repos.name: sql-server-first-responder-kit
repos.notes: Root-level scripts, each a single large stored procedure (sp_Blitz, sp_BlitzCache, sp_BlitzIndex, sp_BlitzFirst, sp_BlitzWho, sp_BlitzLock, sp_DatabaseRestore, etc.) built with idempotent IF OBJECT_ID(...) IS NULL EXEC('CREATE PROCEDURE ... AS RETURN 0;') then ALTER PROCEDURE pattern, plus heavy dynamic SQL construction. Same glob for ddl/proc paths since scripts mix incidental table creation with the procedure body.

repos.name: ola-hallengren-maintenance-solution
repos.notes: Root-level scripts (CommandLog.sql, Queue.sql, QueueDatabase.sql, DatabaseBackup.sql, DatabaseIntegrityCheck.sql, IndexOptimize.sql, MaintenanceSolution.sql). CommandLog.sql/Queue.sql/QueueDatabase.sql contain real CREATE TABLE DDL; the rest are large parameterized stored procedures. Widely deployed in production DBA shops.

repos.name: mojoportal
repos.notes: Fork of the original mojoPortal.org CMS, still maintained. dev3CreateStoredProcedures.sql wraps its CREATE PROCEDURE statements as string literal arguments to EXEC dbo.sp_executesql (idempotent-create pattern), which CLAUDE.md's dynamic SQL policy says is parseable in principle (single string literal, no concatenation) - a good real-world exercise of that rule, distinct from the other 4 repos' plain top-level DDL. mojoPortal.Data.MSSQL/legacyscripts/ contains older upgrade deltas, intentionally excluded here in favor of the dev*.sql full-install scripts.
